authority: games/chess/content/variants/racing-kings.md: 'No move may give check (to either King).'
note: Original divergence was caused by calling MCE's raw legalMoves() instead of variantLegalMoves(). MCE has a moveFilter that enforces the no-check rule. Both implementations agree: 21 opening moves, full agreement over 10 plies.

authority: games/chess/content/variants/antichess.md: 'If a capture is available, you MUST capture.'
note: Original divergence was caused by calling MCE's raw legalMoves() instead of variantLegalMoves(). MCE has a moveFilter that enforces forced captures. Both implementations agree over 10 plies when the correct API is used.
